title: Consciousness requires an entangled quantum system coupled to neurons

statements.text: The main requirement for conscious systems is entangled quantum systems in the brain able to compute and to interact with neurons, sustained in a warm, humid medium. Fisher’s model of entangled Posner molecules, whose phosphorus nuclear spins resist decoherence, is the kind of model needed.

sources.quote: The existence of entangled quantum systems in the brain capable of performing some form of quantum computations and interactions with neurons seems to be the main requirement for conscious systems
One of the most attractive models in this context is the one proposed by Fisher for entangled Posner molecules
